meta.guide_tau: Level caption:  NIST energy and measured lifetime (where one exists).
meta.notes: Level energies are the NIST ASD values (data/nist/Ge_I_levels.tsv); Li et al. and Biemont et al. quote the same levels rounded to 0.01 cm^-1. A_s of E1 lines = measured branching ratio x 1/(measured laser lifetime) as printed by the authors; rme_J_ea0 is derived from that A with the NIST energies (convention of SCHEMA.md, J' = upper level). 4p5s lifetimes and 4p2-4p5s A values come from Biemont et al. 1999 (read directly; Li et al. 1999 reprints them), 4p4d / 4p6s / 4p5d lifetimes and 4p2-4p4d A values from Li et al. 1999. Forbidden-line rates and the metastable lifetimes derived from them are 1964 intermediate-coupling THEORY (Garstang), not measurements. Isotope shifts are nu(first) - nu(second), centre of gravity, natural reference isotope 72Ge. Hyperfine constants refer to 73Ge (I = 9/2). Deverall, Meissner, Zissis, Phys. Rev. 95, 1463 (1954) (abstract) report no resolvable structure in eight Ge I lines and estimate the shift between consecutive even isotopes as smaller than 0.005 cm^-1 (bound).
